explanation.summary: Cosine similarity of TF-IDF word vectors: how much rare vocabulary the two texts share.
explanation.limitations: Lexical only: synonyms and paraphrases do not count, and it cannot tell required from optional skills.

explanation.summary: Cosine similarity of BGE (bge-base-en-v1.5) embeddings of the first 512 tokens of each text: how related the overall topics are.
explanation.limitations: One vector per document: there is no feature-level evidence of which requirements are met. BGE scores fall in a narrow band, so read the category / percentile rather than the raw value.
